strategy.label: top-down model: the acetone-cyanohydrin route the dataset names, amounts from the reaction equation with molar masses, utilities calibrated
strategy.note: NOT S1. No report in the bundle prints an inventory. The dataset's ecoSpold technology field, 'product out of hydrogen cyanide and acetone', is the classic ACH route, and BAFU carries the intermediate as its own dataset ('xx Acetone cyanohydrin, at plant'), so the model is built one step at a time rather than collapsing the two: acetone + HCN -> ACH is the cyanohydrin spec, and this spec is the amidation/esterification step. C4H7NO (acetone cyanohydrin, 85.106) + H2SO4 (98.072) + CH3OH (methanol, 32.042) -> C5H8O2 (methyl methacrylate, 100.117) + NH4HSO4 (ammonium bisulfate, 115.103); mass balance 215.220 = 215.220. Per kg of MMA: 85.106/100.117 = 0.85006 kg of acetone cyanohydrin, 98.072/100.117 = 0.97957 kg of sulphuric acid and 32.042/100.117 = 0.32005 kg of methanol, with 1.14973 kg of ammonium bisulfate as co-product. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990. Amounts fixed, not fitted. The ammonium bisulfate co-product weighs more than the product itself and nothing in the bundle gives an allocation or says whether the plant regenerates the acid, so no credit is taken and that is the single largest uncertainty in this spec. The acetone cyanohydrin input is itself an unflagged eco-profile (rebuilt here), so the structural check flags a dependency.

evidence.where: Cumene / Ethyl benzene / Phosgene / Aniline, at plant [RER]
evidence.note: BAFU template, not a report figure. Every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU-2026 carries the same five-line utility block: 0.333 kWh of 'Electricity, medium voltage, production ENTSO-E, at grid', 2.0 MJ of 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' [CH], 4.0E-10 units of 'Chemical plant, organics', and transport at 0.6 tkm rail + 0.1 tkm lorry per kilogram of precursor. Verified exchange by exchange on Cumene, at plant (0.684 kg benzene + 0.369 kg propylene = 1.053 kg of precursor -> 0.632 tkm rail, 0.105 tkm lorry), Ethyl benzene, at plant (1.030 -> 0.619 / 0.103), Phosgene, liquid, at plant (1.040 -> 0.624 / 0.104) and Aniline, at plant (1.352 -> 0.814 / 0.136). That is the named template this amount comes from.

node.name: Methyl methacrylate, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: Amidation of acetone cyanohydrin with sulphuric acid and esterification with methanol, per kg of MMA. The eight waste-treatment services that the BAFU dataset already carries as explicit exchanges are deliberately not part of this model - they were never collapsed away - following the committed PlasticsEurope specs. The consequence, measured in results/checks/, is that the target's cumulative vector gets a long tail of flows from those disposal chains that no model omitting them can reach.
